en.title: Minimum Adjacent Differences After Replacing Unknown Servers
en.description:
Replace each ? independently with 0 or 1 to minimize the number of adjacent character pairs that differ. Fixed 0/1 characters cannot be changed.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and editorial; additions for bounds missing from the sources and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: One line containing a string made only of 0, 1 and ?. The complete original bounds are 1≤length≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 3 and 0. The explanation of the original second example gives 10 characters, which does not match the 9-character input; a valid optimal filling, 001101111, has length 9 and 3 changes.
hints: Ignore every ? and only count the adjacent changes in the remaining sequence of fixed characters.
